question: How should GASPER_ENVELOPE_MORPH interpolate so rest↔blowfish↔paddle↔question is a living mix, not a snap?
lawfulObject: parameter lerp on the 3-vector (rScale, collapse, hook), then resample the canal. Regularity clamp |Δr|<L−ε every frame. Named rows are presets of that vector.

liveToday.rScale: hard clamp [0.7, 1.07] on the snapped row
liveToday.blendPointSets: 512 xy lerp between FORM_PROFILES — retired as shape authority (E7)
liveToday.sampleRefractoryArc: already the time-ease for profile morphs. Reuse. Do not grow a second clock.

families.parameterLerp: lerp the table columns, then occupiedOutline. Home.
families.logRadius: r(t)=r0·(r1/r0)^t — constant-speed puff. Optional on rScale only.
families.barycentric: w_blow+w_paddle+w_question ≤ 1, rest = 1−Σ. Mix several at once.
families.regularityClamp: after lerp, |r_B−r_A| < L−0.5 on every bone or shrink r, never L.
families.refractoryMix: sampleRefractoryArc(progress) drives the lerp. One clock.
families.PSD_RBF: Lewis 2000 scattered interpolation. Pays off only after off-axis sculpted examples exist.
families.slerp_DQS: Kavan 2008. Right for plant-yaw / bone rotation. Wrong for isotropic puff and plant collapse.
families.silhouetteLerp: blendPointSets. Illegal. Crossfades two inks, not one organism.

regularityDuringMix: uniform rScale preserves σ=(rB−rA)/L. Mixing blowfish (scale) with paddle (plants move, L changes) can push |σ|≥1 mid-blend. Clamp after compose, every frame.
refused: dual-quaternion blend of rest vs blowfish (no rotation to slerp)
RBF with only 4 axial presets (degenerates to the 3-axis lerp)

waves.I: envelopeMode() returns a continuous 3-vector. Snap ids become named presets. collapsePlants is a 0..1 weight.
waves.II: refractory mix between two presets. Reuse sampleRefractoryArc. Regularity clamp.
waves.III: RBF/PSD only if we author off-axis examples (blowfish+paddle as a fifth row).

sources: Lewis, Cordner, Fong — Pose Space Deformation, SIGGRAPH 2000 (scattered, not grid)
Anjyo, Lewis, Pighin — Scattered Data Interpolation for Computer Graphics, SIGGRAPH Courses 2014
Lewis — PSD web notes (smooth vs linear / hyperlinear)
Kavan et al. — Geometric Skinning with Approximate Dual Quaternion Blending, 2008
Shoemake — Animating Rotation with Quaternion Curves (slerp), SIGGRAPH 1985
in-house sampleRefractoryArc + blendPointSets (the latter is the dual)
fix: none this pass. Dual + interpolator spec only.
